subject: general
question:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

A society or company provides these convenient features
solution:
The correct answer* *is ***Option 4)***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Amenities"** refers to useful or pleasant facilities or services provided by a society or company to enhance comfort or convenience. (सुविधाएं)

 
 
• **Example:** The hotel offers various*** amenities ***like free Wi-Fi, a swimming pool, and a fitness center.
 
 
 
• **"Amenities"** in English means features that provide comfort, convenience, or enjoyment. (सुविधाएं)
 
 
• **Example:** Modern office buildings are equipped with ***amenities*** such as cafeterias and conference rooms.
 
 

Hence, the word that means the same as "**A society or company provides these convenient features**" is **"Amenities"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Equipment** (उपकरण): The necessary items for a particular purpose.

 
 
• **Example:** The laboratory is fully stocked with the latest scientific **equipment.**
 
 
 
• **Facilitate** (सुविधाजनक बनाना): To make an action or process easy or easier.
 
 
• **Example:** The new software will **facilitate **the management of our customer data.
 
 
 
• **System** (प्रणाली): A set of connected things or parts forming a complex whole.
 
 
• **Example:** The solar** system **consists of the sun and the objects that orbit it.
